Symbioen monitors and verifies the performance of public and private EV chargers. 

Measuring charging performance is difficult because every operator defines it differently. The gap between claimed and actual performance creates The gap between claimed and actual performance creates financial and reputational risks across the industry.

To mitigate such risks Symbioen provides unified EV charging KPIs built on open regulatory data. This makes it possible to compare any network, operator, or region against the same baseline. 

For operators, Symbioen offers independent proof of network performance in front of customers, partners, and tenders. Investors and public bodies share a related need: comparable, objective data — whether for due diligence and portfolio monitoring or for understanding how charging performs across areas and regions. Site hosts and EV fleets use the same KPI data to hold charging providers accountable. The reports Symbioen produces cover both individual site metrics and aggregated regional trends. 

For questions, partnerships, or access to public or private reports, reach out at vadim@symbioen.com or visit symbioen.com.
